prompt: The dog would have stayed inside if Cian (to close) the park gate.
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом, которое уже нельзя изменить: в части с if для третьего типа используется Past Perfect (had closed).

prompt: Kofi would have passed the class if he (not / to forget) his project.
explanation_ru: Кофи забыл проект и не сдал работу; для нереального условия в прошлом после if нужен отрицательный Past Perfect (hadn't forgotten).

prompt: Youssef closed his stall at noon; if he (to wait) two hours, he (to sell) everything to the festival crowd.
explanation_ru: Ситуация уже в прошлом: в условии ставим Past Perfect (had waited), а в результате — would/could/might have + V3.

prompt: — Why did nobody eat the soup? — If I (to taste) it first, I (not / to add) so much salt.
explanation_ru: Суп уже пересолили, и это невозможно исправить: после if идёт Past Perfect (had tasted), а в главной части — wouldn't have added.

prompt: Petra left her shop unlocked overnight; the thief (not / to get) in if she (to check) the back door.
explanation_ru: Кража уже произошла, поэтому в главной части стоит wouldn't/couldn't have got, а в придаточном с if — Past Perfect (had checked).

prompt: We fell out at my friend's party in Osaka. If I (not / to leave) so early, we (to talk) it through.
explanation_ru: Вечеринка и ссора уже позади: сожаление о прошлом передаётся через if + hadn't left и would/could/might have talked.

prompt: Before Pádraig cleared the trees along the field, nobody warned him that the stream would dry up; if he (to know) how they sheltered the water, he (not / to cut) them down.
explanation_ru: Деревья уже срублены, поэтому оба действия относятся к прошлому: Past Perfect в условии (had known) и wouldn't have cut в результате.

prompt: According to Bao's report from the riverside site in Hanoi, the ancient wooden boat (to survive) the flood if the team (to move) it to higher ground before the river rose.
explanation_ru: Наводнение уже случилось, и лодку не успели перенести: главная часть требует would/could/might have survived, а часть с if — had moved.

prompt: Two years ago, we sold our old piano to save space in the living room. Six months later, my daughter asked to start music lessons! If we (not / to sell) it, she (to practise) at home every day. (you / to keep) it in our place?
explanation_ru: Вся история о прошлом решении продать пианино: отрицание в условии (hadn't sold), результат (would have practised) и вопрос в третьем типе (Would you have kept).

prompt: Aisha reached the platform in Alexandria with ten minutes to spare, only to realise her passport was still on her kitchen table. She watched the overnight train pull away without her. If she (to pack) her bag the night before, she (not / to miss) the trip. She (to arrive) in Cairo by breakfast.
explanation_ru: Поезд уже ушёл, поэтому нереальное условие и оба его воображаемых последствия в прошлом строятся по третьему типу: had packed, wouldn't have missed и would have arrived.

prompt: Dark clouds rolled across the farm while June was driving the cows to the far field. Half an hour later, heavy hail forced everyone back to the barn. If she (to read) the weather warning that morning, she (to leave) the animals safely near the house. The wooden gate (not / to break) in the rush.
explanation_ru: Град уже прошёл и ворота сломались: в условии используется Past Perfect (had read), а в последствиях — would have left и wouldn't have broken.

prompt: The baby panda in Singapore arrived a week earlier than anyone had expected. Luckily, Mei Ling had already set up the warm room the weekend before. If the staff (not / to prepare) the room in advance, the first night (to be) chaotic. Even a short delay (to put) the tiny cub at risk.
explanation_ru: Рождение панды и та ночь уже в прошлом: мы представляем, что случилось бы без подготовки, через hadn't prepared и would/could/might have + V3.

prompt: When the coastal storm hit French Guiana, Sophie's team stopped the countdown with three minutes left. Some managers complained about the lost week, so Sophie reviewed the wind data. If the rocket (to take) off in those gusts, the side winds (to damage) the outer shell. (the mission / to succeed) under those conditions? Almost certainly not.
explanation_ru: Запуск отменили во время прошлого шторма, поэтому гипотетический сценарий требует had taken, would/could/might have damaged и вопроса Would/Could the mission have succeeded.

prompt: Last winter, a storm brought down the roof of the rebuilt Roman villa near Naples. Giulia inspected the damage and saw cheap nails in the frame. If the builders (to choose) stronger wood, the roof (not / to fall) in the wind. The whole hall (to stay) open to visitors all spring.
explanation_ru: Крыша уже обрушилась прошлой зимой, поэтому для другого исхода нужны Past Perfect (had chosen) и формы would (not) have + V3.

prompt: If Dan ___ his ticket, he would have heard the concert.
options: wouldn't have sold
hadn't sold
didn't sell
hadn't sell
explanation_ru: После if в третьем типе используется Past Perfect (hadn't sold). Типичная ошибка — ставить would have после if или забывать третью форму глагола.

prompt: Zeynep put her brushes away after school; she ___ a much better painter if she had kept drawing.
options: would become
would had become
could have become
had become
explanation_ru: В главной части третьего типа нужна связка would/could/might + have + V3 (could have become). Вариант would had — частая ошибка с неправильным вспомогательным глаголом.

prompt: My test score in Seoul was terrible. If I ___ to the revision class, I wouldn't have made those mistakes.
options: would have gone
had went
went
had gone
explanation_ru: Для нереального условия в прошлом нужен Past Perfect с третьей формой глагола (had gone). Частые ошибки — had + вторая форма (had went) и would have после if.

prompt: Anong turned the cooker down in time — the hot oil ___ fire if she had waited another minute.
options: might have caught
might catch
would had caught
had caught
explanation_ru: Масло едва не загорелось в прошлом, поэтому нужна перфектная форма модального глагола might have caught, а не might catch или would had.

prompt: During the power cut on the Saint Petersburg metro, I missed the earlier train, though I ___ stuck in the dark tunnel for forty minutes if I'd caught it.
options: would be
would have been
had been
would had been
explanation_ru: Сокращение I'd caught здесь означает I had caught (Past Perfect), поэтому в главной части о прошлом нужно would have been, а не would be.

prompt: If Nadia would have checked the price, she would have paid less.
answer: If Nadia had checked the price, she would have paid less.
accepted_answers: If Nadia had checked the price, she would have paid less.
If Nadia had checked the price, she'd have paid less.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить would have в придаточном с if по аналогии с русским «если бы». После if нужен Past Perfect (had checked).

prompt: I wouldn't have lost my best friend if I had wrote a calmer message before clicking send.
answer: I wouldn't have lost my best friend if I had written a calmer message before clicking send.
accepted_answers: I wouldn't have lost my best friend if I had written a calmer message before clicking send.
I would not have lost my best friend if I had written a calmer message before clicking send.
I wouldn't have lost my best friend if I'd written a calmer message before clicking send.
I would not have lost my best friend if I'd written a calmer message before clicking send.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в форме глагола после had: в Past Perfect нужна третья форма (had written), а не вторая (had wrote).

prompt: If I'd woken up ten minutes earlier at the hostel, I'd have caught the last tour bus to the palace.
answer: If I'd woken up ten minutes earlier at the hostel, I'd have caught the last tour bus to the palace.
accepted_answers: If I'd woken up ten minutes earlier at the hostel, I'd have caught the last tour bus to the palace.
explanation_ru: Предложение полностью верно: первое I'd расшифровывается как I had (I had woken up), а второе — как I would (I would have caught).

prompt: Deniz laughed about the chase afterwards and admitted that he would had caught the thief if he hadn't locked his keys inside the police car.
answer: Deniz laughed about the chase afterwards and admitted that he would have caught the thief if he hadn't locked his keys inside the police car.
accepted_answers: Deniz laughed about the chase afterwards and admitted that he would have caught the thief if he hadn't locked his keys inside the police car.
Deniz laughed about the chase afterwards and admitted that he'd have caught the thief if he hadn't locked his keys inside the police car.
Deniz laughed about the chase afterwards and admitted that he would have caught the thief if he had not locked his keys inside the police car.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола would всегда используется инфинитив have, а не had: правильно would have caught.

prompt: Dino found out about the Zagreb TV audition one day too late, so he never got a chance to try for the main part.
options: If Dino heard about the audition earlier, he would try for the main part.
If Dino had heard about the audition earlier, he could have tried for the main part.
If Dino wouldn't have heard about the audition late, he would have tried for the main part.
If Dino hadn't heard about the audition earlier, he could have tried for the main part.
explanation_ru: Прослушивание уже прошло, и Дино узнал о нём поздно: нужен третий тип с противоположным смыслом (if he had heard..., he could have tried).

prompt: In Barcelona, Pablo painted over an old wall in a hurry without stepping back first, and only later did he realise he had covered a famous street painting.
options: Pablo wouldn't have covered the famous painting if he had stopped to look at the wall first.
Pablo would have covered the famous painting if he had stopped to look at the wall first.
Pablo wouldn't cover the famous painting if he stopped to look at the wall first.
Pablo wouldn't have covered the famous painting if he would have stopped to look at the wall first.
explanation_ru: Событие завершилось в прошлом, поэтому подходит только третий тип без would после if и с правильной полярностью (wouldn't have covered... if he had stopped).

prompt: Iva arrived late at the festival, so she missed her favourite band. → If Iva hadn't …
answer: If Iva hadn't arrived late at the festival, she wouldn't have missed her favourite band.
accepted_answers: If Iva hadn't arrived late at the festival, she wouldn't have missed her favourite band.
If Iva hadn't arrived late at the festival, she would not have missed her favourite band.
If Iva had not arrived late at the festival, she wouldn't have missed her favourite band.
If Iva had not arrived late at the festival, she would not have missed her favourite band.
explanation_ru: Оба факта в прошлом были утвердительными (arrived, missed), поэтому в третьем типе обе части меняют знак на отрицательный: hadn't arrived и wouldn't have missed.

prompt: Zofia didn't turn down the flame, so the glass jar cracked. → The glass jar …
answer: The glass jar wouldn't have cracked if Zofia had turned down the flame.
accepted_answers: The glass jar wouldn't have cracked if Zofia had turned down the flame.
The glass jar would not have cracked if Zofia had turned down the flame.
The glass jar wouldn't have cracked if Zofia had turned the flame down.
The glass jar would not have cracked if Zofia had turned the flame down.
The glass jar wouldn't have cracked had Zofia turned down the flame.
explanation_ru: Меняем реальные события в прошлом на противоположные: банка не треснула бы (wouldn't have cracked), если бы Зофия убавила огонь (had turned down).

prompt: I forgot my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, so I couldn't show the unusual stone to my professor. → If I hadn't …
answer: If I hadn't forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I could have shown the unusual stone to my professor.
accepted_answers: If I hadn't forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I could have shown the unusual stone to my professor.
If I had not forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I could have shown the unusual stone to my professor.
If I hadn't forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I would have been able to show the unusual stone to my professor.
If I had not forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I would have been able to show the unusual stone to my professor.
If I hadn't forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I'd have been able to show the unusual stone to my professor.
If I hadn't forgotten my bag of rock samples on the Jaipur train, I would have shown the unusual stone to my professor.
explanation_ru: Реальное couldn't show в прошлом превращается в нереальную возможность could have shown, а условие строится через Past Perfect (hadn't forgotten).

prompt: If Cecilia had taken the film part, she would have met the director.
options: Cecilia took the film part and met the director.
Cecilia did not take the film part and did not meet the director.
Cecilia does not take the film part and does not meet the director.
Cecilia did not take the film part, but she met the director.
explanation_ru: Третий тип описывает прошлое наоборот: обе части утвердительные, значит на самом деле Сесилия не взяла роль и не встретилась с режиссёром.

prompt: Noor wouldn't have got the bank interview if she hadn't studied finance.
options: Noor didn't study finance and didn't get the bank interview.
Noor studies finance, so she gets a bank interview.
Noor studied finance and got the bank interview.
Noor studied finance, but she didn't get the bank interview.
explanation_ru: Обе части условного предложения стоят в отрицании, значит в реальном прошлом всё произошло наоборот: Нур изучала финансы и получила собеседование.

prompt: If Lola hadn't stayed for her friend's wedding in Barcelona ten years ago, she wouldn't have opened her photo studio there.
options: Lola stayed for the wedding in Barcelona and opened her photo studio there.
Lola left before the wedding in Barcelona and did not open her photo studio there.
Lola stayed for the wedding in Barcelona, so she never opened her photo studio there.
Lola stays in Barcelona for weddings and opens photo studios.
explanation_ru: Два отрицания в третьем типе (hadn't stayed, wouldn't have opened) показывают, что в реальности Лола осталась на свадьбу и открыла там студию.

prompt: I'd never have opened my own noodle bar in Shanghai if I'd stayed at the big hotel kitchen.
options: The speaker stayed at the big hotel kitchen and never opened a noodle bar.
The speaker did not stay at the big hotel kitchen and did not open a noodle bar.
The speaker is staying at the big hotel kitchen and will not open a noodle bar.
The speaker left the big hotel kitchen and opened a noodle bar in Shanghai.
explanation_ru: Здесь I'd never have opened = отрицание, а I'd stayed = утверждение, поэтому в реальном прошлом рассказчик ушёл из кухни отеля и открыл лапшичную.

prompt: Evelyn might have spent that long winter in the cottage completely alone if she hadn't taken in the stray dog she found by the garden gate.
options: Evelyn did not take in the stray dog and spent that winter alone in the cottage.
Evelyn took in the stray dog, so she did not spend that winter alone in the cottage.
Evelyn takes in stray dogs so that she is never alone in winter.
Evelyn took in the stray dog, yet she still spent that winter completely alone.
explanation_ru: Условие hadn't taken in означает, что Эвелин взяла собаку, а утвердительное might have spent alone — что в итоге она не провела ту зиму в одиночестве.

prompt: Match the halves of these sentences about Marek's career choice.
pairs: If Marek had finished his space course in Brno,
he could have worked at the science centre.
If his parents hadn't urged him to pick a safe job,
they wouldn't have argued all summer.
Would you have taken that office job
if someone had offered you a place on the course?
If I'd been in Marek's shoes back then,
I'd have stayed up watching the night sky.
explanation_ru: Все четыре предложения относятся к прошлому выбору Марека и соединяются по смыслу, подлежащему и форме (утверждение, отрицание, вопрос и сокращение 'd).

prompt: A message from Tokyo after a long visit to the dentist.
sentences: I ignored a bad toothache in Tokyo for months because I was scared of the dentist.
If I would have booked an appointment in March, the treatment would have been over in one short visit.
Instead, I waited until the pain kept me awake all night and needed three separate sessions.
My dentist said I wouldn't had needed any painful work if I'd come in earlier.
At least I've learnt my lesson and won't put off a check-up next time.

fixes.1: If I had booked an appointment in March, the treatment would have been over in one short visit.
fixes.3: My dentist said I wouldn't have needed any painful work if I'd come in earlier.

explanation_ru: В предложении 2 допущена ошибка would have после if (нужен Past Perfect: had booked), а в предложении 4 — неверная связка wouldn't had вместо wouldn't have.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Would Leila have left her old job if she'd known?
accepted_answers: Would Leila have left her old job if she'd known?
explanation_ru: В вопросе третьего типа на первое место выходит Would, затем подлежащее (Leila), have + V3 (have left), а придаточное с if строится в Past Perfect (she'd known).
